title: Southeast coastal garden
caption: A public loop now joins the pergola, open lawn, jumping stones and sea-facing benches, with clear paths back to the dorm row and terrace.

sections.title: Finished garden: morning and evening
sections.caption: All 28 final southeast views passed personal inspection and independent visual review at 8/10 or better.

sections.title: Using the garden with the final navigation
sections.caption: Both native formats repeat the bench, running jump, stable stone landing and east-lane, sports and commons return routes after the navigation repair.

sections.title: Original lookout remains available
sections.caption: Focused day-two checks preserve the lookout and shrine paths, Hamada’s after-shift availability and the existing sports closure.

sections.title: Before: dense planting and unused southern grounds
sections.caption: The original approach, pergola, shore, rest-court site, building join, terrace and horizon at both native formats and times of day.

sections.title: First captured attempt: rejected
sections.caption: Paths and seating were useful, but phone roofs and trees obscured approaches, the desktop terrace hid the actor, and the sea looked flat. These pictures led to another pass.

sections.title: Second captured attempt: revised again
sections.caption: The sea and shore/building views improved. Personal inspection still rejected the phone approach roof and the compressed desktop terrace camera.

sections.title: Jump input attempt 1: missed landing
sections.caption: The first desktop jump reached the stone too late. Seating passed; this jump attempt did not.

sections.title: Jump input attempt 2: overshot
sections.caption: The desktop jump cleared the stone but continued beyond it. Input timing was adjusted; the scene and physics stayed unchanged.

sections.title: Jump input attempt 3: stopped early
sections.caption: The desktop jump stopped before the stone face. Retained as a failed input attempt.

sections.title: Focused jump attempt 4: passed
sections.caption: The first successful focused sitting, jumping and stable stone landing at both native formats. Full route reproduction follows below.

sections.title: Full recreation and return routes: passed
sections.caption: The complete first successful route run shows sitting, jumping, landing and returns at both native formats. The final-navigation rerun is shown above.

sections.title: Startup attempt: no captures
sections.caption: The initial round1 startup stopped because the three new public spots lacked catalog declarations. Those declarations were fixed before round1-attempt2; no pictures were produced. The navigation regression has a report and no additional screenshots.
